ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors and authorized signatories against the CSSF consolidated list, United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions Lists, Luxembourg national territorial bans, OFAC SDN List (where USD payments or correspondent banking are involved), and the PEP database maintained by the Luxembourg Financial Intelligence Unit (Cellule de Renseignement Financier). Enhanced due diligence is applied to politically exposed persons, including Chinese PEPs, state-owned enterprise officials or persons under media scrutiny. A written UBO questionnaire, source-of-wealth declaration and sanctions screening report must be retained by the notary and the Luxembourg incorporation file.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Luxembourg Business Registers – Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) online portal (https://www.lbr.lu)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The proposed name must be written using the Latin alphabet. If the Chinese pastry brand name is originally in Chinese characters, a Latin-script phonetic transliteration or an internationally recognised Latin-alphabet trade name must be registered. Public filings are made in French; a certified translation of the name into French, German, English or Luxembourgish may be required by the RCS. The name must be distinctive, not misleading, not contrary to public order and must comply with the amended Law of 19 December 2002 on the register of commerce and companies.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon refusal of a proposed name, the applicant or its Luxembourg attorney may, within 15 days from notification, file a written administrative appeal with the competent registration chamber of the Luxembourg District Court. The appeal must be introduced through an authorized Luxembourg attorney and shall demonstrate that the proposed name does not infringe the grounds of refusal, notably public order, evasion of law, misleading character or conflict with an existing registered name. As an alternative, a reconsideration request may be submitted to the Registrar of the Luxembourg Business Registers. If the refusal is based on ministerial approval-related protected words, the applicant may apply to the relevant ministry (e.g., Ministry of Justice, Ministry of Finance, or Ministry of the Economy) and, if necessary, pursue an administrative appeal before the Luxembourg Administrative Tribunal under the amended law on administrative procedure.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office may be accepted only as a temporary administrative seat for the pre-incorporation phase. Permanent virtual registration is not permissible for a specialty fresh bakery franchise and central kitchen operation because the business requires an actual commercial domicile in Luxembourg for food-safety approvals, tax/VAT registration, employment controls and administrative substance. Law-firm domiciliation services are acceptable only for non-operative SCSp holding vehicles; here, a physical lease or ownership title is required.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk: 45% probability within 12 months of registration that qualified authorities (Luxembourg Food Safety Administration – ASTA, Luxembourg Social Security Centre – CNS, or the RCS/AML supervisory authorities) will conduct an unannounced physical on-site inspection due to the food-operation sector and employee setup; additional 10% probability of random AML/UBO documentary or physical checks by the Luxembourg Business Registers or CSSF within the first two years.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Luxembourg Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies, as amended; Articles 904-1 to 904-12 (Société en Commandite Spéciale) inserted by the Law of 23 July 2016; complemented by the Law of 25 July 2023 on classified establishments for operational permits.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) - Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), 1b Boulevard Royal, L-2449 Luxembourg
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Déclaration de souscription et d'exécution (subscription and payment statement) filed together with the executed partnership agreement (contrat de société) on Form LT-1.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for an SCSp; the partnership agreement freely determines contributions. No escrow account or bank capital-blocking certificate is legally required, but contributions must be fully effective and verifiable at RCS registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED by the managing partner of LU SCSP BAKERY P.S.C., S.C.Sp. as follows: (1) The subscriptions of the initial special partners to the partnership interests are hereby approved and confirmed; all contributions in cash or in kind shall be credited as set out in the partnership agreement. (2) The registered office of the partnership is hereby adopted at [address], Grand Duchy of Luxembourg, and the managing partner is authorized to execute and file all notices of adoption. (3) Upon registration with the Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register, the undersigned persons shall act as managing partners with full powers of administration. (4) All steps ancillary to registration, including engaging the filing agent and settling official fees, are hereby ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) - Online RCS Search Portal, www.lbr.lu
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Run a free availability search on the LBR portal for the proposed corporate name against registered trade names and partnerships. Submit a priority reservation request with up to three alternative names. Confirm the name includes the legal form suffix 'S.C.Sp.' or the full wording 'Société en Commandite Spéciale' and does not infringe prior trademarks.
required_dossiers: Proposed corporate name (primary and two alternates)
Power of attorney if filed through an approved filing agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry refuses the name as identical or confusingly similar, resubmit the alternative names on the same portal; an administrative appeal lies to the President of the District Court of Luxembourg within 8 days of the refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of the SCSp Partnership Agreement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg notary (required for contributions of immovable property) or private signature with optional notarization of signatures
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the partnership agreement (contrat de société) in French or English with Luxembourg governing law, identifying the general partner/managing partner and the special partner(s), capital contributions, profit-sharing ratio, transfer restrictions, and management powers. Execute before a Luxembourg notary when real property or notarized form is required by the financing bank; otherwise execute by private signature. Notarized signatures are strongly recommended to facilitate corporate bank account opening and KYC.
required_dossiers: Passports or national IDs of all partners
Proof of registered office address (lease contract or registered-office service agreement)
Statutory declaration of the general partner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or any partner requires corrections, execute a rectifying deed (acte rectificatif) before the same notary and re-submit the corrected deed to the parties.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of the Registration Dossier with the Luxembourg Register of Commerce and Companies
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (RCS) - eJustice/LBR electronic filing portal or paper filing counter, 1b Boulevard Royal, L-2449 Luxembourg
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the executed partnership agreement together with Form LT-1, registered office consent, managerial acceptance letters, and the mandatory beneficial owner (RBE) declaration. Pay the statutory registration fee. RCS verifies identity, name legality, and deed compliance; the SCSp acquires legal personality on the date of filing and issuance of the registration extract.
required_dossiers: Acceptance of functions by each managing partner
Consent of the registered office provider
RBE (Register of Beneficial Owners) declaration form
Proof of payment of the RCS filing fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar issues a rectification query, remedy the deficiencies within one month by submitting corrected forms or supplemental notarial deeds; failure to cure results in deemed withdrawal, requiring a fresh filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Automatic Publication of the Legal Extract in the Electronic Compendium (RESA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers - RESA electronic gazette, www.lbr.lu/resaj
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: No separate application is required: RCS automatically transmits the registration extract to RESA for publication free of charge. Verify within 48 hours that the published extract correctly reflects the legal form (SCSp), registered office, managing partners, and capital contribution. Download the certified publication extract as formation proof for bank KYC and the VAT administration.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the published extract contains errors, file a rectification request with the RCS; the corrected extract is republished within 24-48 hours.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax, VAT, Social Security, and UBO Register Filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT); Centre Commun de la Sécurité Sociale (CCSS); Luxembourg Business Registers (RBE)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit VAT registration Form 1 to AEDT to obtain the national business identification number. Register the SCSp as an employer with CCSS if the central kitchen will hire staff. File the UBO declaration with the RBE. Confirm pass-through tax treatment (non-tax-transparent SCSp) unless an election is made; obtain the Luxembourg business number and VAT number before signing the bakery lease or supply contracts.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If AEDT queries the residence or activity code (ISIC 5610), resubmit with the lease contract and a short business plan; VAT registration is automatic within 10 days once the dossier is complete.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministère de l'Économie - Direction de l'Industrie, jointly with Administration luxembourgeoise vétérinaire et alimentaire (ALVA) for food hygiene approval
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Autorisation d'exploitation d'un établissement classé (classified establishment operating permit) and agrément/enregistrement sanitaire of the food business operator under Regulation (EC) No 853/2004

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Administration de l'environnement - Inspection Générale de l'Environnement (IGE), Ministry of the Environment, Climate and Biodiversity
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Class 3 (authorization) for a central kitchen with cooking capacity above 300 kg/day; Class 4 (simple declaration) for retail pastry counters; a full EIA report is not required below the Annex thresholds of the Law of 25 July 2023 on classified establishments
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge limits per the Règlement grand-ducal of 15 May 2018: BOD5 <= 25 mg/L, COD <= 125 mg/L, TSS <= 35 mg/L, fats/oils/greases <= 10 mg/L; kitchen exhaust VOC ceilings under Directive 1999/13/EC (<= 50 mg C/Nm3); food waste and used cooking oil must be tracked and removed by an approved collector under the SuperDrecksKëscht scheme

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate (certificat de sécurité incendie) issued by the Corps grand-ducal d'incendie et de secours (CGDIS) after inspection of fryers, ovens, and extraction ducts; structural stability inspection by an approved engineer for ovens and refrigeration halls; occupational health and workplace registration with the Inspection du Travail et des Mines (ITM) under the Luxembourg Labor Code.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Luxembourg direct tax authority: Administration des contributions directes (ACD, portal: myguichet.lu / eCDF). Indirect tax authority: Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT) for VAT registration and VAT returns.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Société en Commandite Spéciale (SCSp) is registered with the Luxembourg Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) to obtain a Luxembourg business registration number (matricule). For income tax purposes the SCSp is statutorily fiscally transparent, so no corporate income tax registration is required at partnership level unless otherwise elected or where it carries on a commercial activity with legal personality. For VAT, a foreign entity performing taxable activities in Luxembourg (such as a central kitchen or franchisor supplying goods/services through a Luxembourg SCSp) must submit a VAT registration application on the standard AEDT form (Formulaire no. 10) before commencing taxable supplies; the resulting Luxembourg VAT identification number (TVAN) is used for EU intra-community transactions.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Luxembourg does not operate a US-style check-the-box system. An SCSp formed under the amended Law of 10 August 1915 is fiscally transparent by default, unless it opts to be treated as a taxable entity by making a formal election to be treated as a société en commandite simple (SCS) for corporate-law and therefore tax purposes. Hybrid mismatch elections required under ATAD may be made where applicable, but the tax transparency of the SCSp remains the default.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (TVA - Taxe sur la valeur ajoutée)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EUR 35,000 small business exemption threshold for Luxembourg resident taxable persons; non-established foreign entities are required to register for VAT from the first euro of taxable supplies made in Luxembourg, subject to EU distance-selling and reverse-charge rules.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing for business-to-government (B2G) transactions using the PEPPOL network; no statutory real-time fiscal clearance, no digital stamping or continuous transaction controls apply to private-sector B2B/B2C invoicing in Luxembourg.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: The export of goods to a destination outside the European Union qualifies for VAT zero-rating when the seller retains proof of physical export, such as the customs export declaration (SAD/electronic declaration), transport documentation (CMR/AWB/Bill of Lading), and evidence that the goods left EU territory. Supplies of goods to a taxable person in another EU Member State are zero-rated if the customer's VAT identification number is valid and the goods are dispatched or transported to that Member State. Offshore services supplied to a non-EU customer may be outside of the scope Luxembourg VAT; supply of services to an EU taxable person is generally subject to reverse charge and therefore not a zero-rated export in the 'export' sense but reduces Luxembourg VAT burden.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs export declaration (Electronic SAD / Export Summary Declaration)
Bill of Lading, CMR road consignment note, or Air Waybill
Commercial invoice (NG or purchase order and final price)
Proof of payment from foreign recipient (bank SWIFT / wire transfer instruction)
Intra-community declaration (if EU movement via Luxembourg and valid EU VAT IDs)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Luxembourg AEDT may retrospectively claw back undeclared VAT and deny zero-rating where the supplier fails to provide adequate proof of export, misstates the nature of the supply, or participates in a missing-trader fraud. Penalties include fines up to EUR 20,000, default interest of 10% per annum, administrative penalties of up to EUR 250,000 under the General Tax Law for deliberate tax evasion, and criminal sanctions including imprisonment for aggravated VAT fraud. The SCSp and the general partner may be jointly and severally liable for VAT debts.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque centrale du Luxembourg (BCL); the Luxembourg Ministry of Finance and the Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF) share supervisory functions, although no standalone foreign exchange administration is constituted in Luxembourg.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Luxembourg applies full eurozone monetary integration; both capital and current account transactions are convertible without governmental exchange control permit. EU Treaty free movement of capital (TFEU Arts. 63-65) applies, and only standard AML/CFT, sanctioned-party screening, statistical reporting and tax withholding characterization obligations may apply. Profit remittance by an SCSp (e.g., partnership distributions to foreign partners) is not subject to FX approval; residual constraints are exclusively those of the remitting bank's KYC/onboarding policies and any withholding arising from sourced Luxembourg income.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no statutory surrender obligation, minimum conversion ratio, or mandatory repatriation timeline for export proceeds in Luxembourg. Export receipts may be retained in Euro or any freely convertible settlement currency, subject only to the general obligation to keep accounting records in Euro-equivalent terms and to report suspicious cross-border transactions under the amended Luxembourg AML/CFT law and applicable CSSF regulations.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account and Operational Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Banque et Caisse d'Épargne de l'État (Spuerkeess)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium. A Luxembourg-authorised e-money institution (EMI) or payment institution supervised by the CSSF can provide a valid secondary payment account and cheaper cross-border clearing; offshore digital EMIs that are not EU/EEA-licensed generally cannot open a compliance-grade Luxembourg corporate account. Such fintech rails are legally viable for POS and royalty collection but should not replace a tier-1 commercial clearing bank for capital calls, treasury concentration, or LC-backed trade disbursement.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is not imposed by statute, but standard Luxembourg banking practice requires at least one authorised officer/manager or beneficial owner to appear in person for identity verification at account opening; a remote opening process (secure video call plus digital identity, notarised/apostilled entity documentation and CSSF-compliant UBO declaration) is increasingly accepted for a Low_Risk_Standard bakery franchise treasury if ultimate ownership is transparent and source-of-funds documentation is complete. In-person KYC interview remains the safest onboarding route and materially shortens compliance decisions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: SCSp structure opacity: substantial UBO identification gaps, nominee limited partners or undisclosed GP/manager control.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Official Luxembourg trade register (RCS) extract, partnership agreement and articles of association, updated UBO register declaration, organisational chart showing direct and indirect ownership, notarised passport copies of every natural-person UBO, board resolution authorising account opening, and source-of-wealth/enhanced due-diligence questionnaire for non-EU partners.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Chinese pastry chain trademark and royalty flows: inbound franchise fees from China or outbound royalty remittances to Asia create intellectual property and cross-border related-party exposure.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed master franchise and sub-franchise agreements, royalty calculation and payment schedule, chain-of-title trademark registrations, arm's-length transfer pricing documentation, forecast cash flows, invoices and tax certificates from both sides, and legal opinion on income characterisation and EU/China tax treaty protection.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cash-intensive bakery/POS revenues: large-volume low-denomination cash deposits and retail settlement inconsistencies trigger cash-origins suspicion.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: POS terminal provider agreement and settlement statements, daily/monthly sales reconciliation, cash-in-transit contracts, central kitchen purchase invoices, major supplier list, payroll records and VAT/GST returns, internal controls narrative, and bank reference from incumbent retail collection bank.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border counterparties and sanctions exposure: payments to non-EU suppliers or through correspondent banks create transactional friction.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full KYB/KYC file for material counterparties, sanctions/PEP screening outputs (automated), purpose codes and underlying commercial contracts for each payment corridor, bilateral trade licences if any, third-party due-diligence reports, audited financial statements, and a sworn declaration that no beneficial owner is subject to EU/UN sanctions.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Equity and shareholder-loan injections are transmitted by SWIFT MT103 or, within the EU, SEPA Credit Transfer from the investor's bank, using the correct money-creation purpose code (e.g., 'Capital Increase / Shareholder Loan' code). In Luxembourg no official approval is required, but the source country must be cleared first; Chinese outbound investment remittance under SAFE/FDI rules must be structured as a lawful equity subscription or intra-group loan with prior registration. Every inward credit must be matched against a capital call notice, a signed subscription document, and an updated UBO/sanctions-negative certification to avoid frozen funds. The receiving bank will also apply EU cash-control and AML wire-transfer identification requirements where applicable.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: High-value supplier payments use SWIFT MT103 with full invoice reference and ISIC-compliant trade purpose code; import/export settlements for central kitchen machinery and baking inputs are secured through commercial letters of credit issued via SWIFT MT700 and settled under UCP600 with TARGET2/T2 clearing. Euro-area payroll and franchisee rebate payments use SEPA Credit Transfer (SCT) and SEPA Instant Credit Transfer (SCT Inst); intraday and end-of-day treasury concentration is cleared through TARGET2 for real-time gross settlement and bank-internal liquidity pools. All outward wires in foreign currency are executed only via the Luxembourg credit institution's nostro/correspondent network after sanctions/AML screening.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable outright EUR/USD and EUR/CNY forward contracts with a CSSF-licensed credit institution
Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing onshore CNH/CNY for settlement of Chinese franchise inflows where deliverability is restricted
Plain-vanilla cross-currency interest-rate swaps converting floating-rate USD or RMB exposures into EUR
FX swaps (spot-forward combinations) for temporary treasury liquidity conversion without taking speculative open risk
European-style FX options bought from an EU/EEA bank for hedging tender or royalty-fee translation risk
Foreign exchange forwards structured in compliance with ESMA regulatory technical standards on benchmarks, MiFID II derivative eligibility and EMIR clearing thresholds

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation of beneficial owners (confirmation annuelle RBE)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs (RBE) administered by Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one calendar month after the anniversary of the entity's initial RBE registration; thereafter annually on the same anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines up to EUR 250,000 and criminal prosecution of the managing partner for intentional inaccuracy or repeated non-confirmation; the entity may be struck off from the RBE for persistent default

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual accounts (comptes annuels) deposit, including abridged accounts for qualifying small SCSp
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) / Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) through RESA electronic filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within seven months after the financial year-end; for a 31 December year-end, the deadline is 31 July of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Judicial coercive fine (astreinte) up to EUR 2,500, RCS public notice of non-compliance, and criminal sanctions against the gérant for failure to file; continued default may justify court-ordered dissolution

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Luxembourg income tax information return for the fiscally transparent partnership
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Administration des Contributions Directes (ACD), competent bureau d'imposition of the registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Paper returns due by 30 April of the following tax year; electronic filing normally extended to 31 May or 30 June when filed through a Luxembourg tax professional
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing surcharge, monthly default interest at 0.6% of any assessed partner tax, and criminal penalties for deliberate failure to file or knowingly false partnership allocation statements

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual notification and facility update for the licensed central bakery kitchen and franchise bake-shops
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Health / Administration des Services Vétérinaires (ASV), food safety and establishment licensing division
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual renewal or confirmation is due no later than 30 days before the anniversary of each food establishment agrément; immediate notification required upon any material change in production capacity, storage, or product list
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Suspension, restriction, or withdrawal of the food establishment agrément; administrative fines up to EUR 25,000; closure of the central kitchen or bakery unit pending corrective action

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual registered office and domiciliation confirmation statement
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Domiciliation agent, reporting as required to the Luxembourg Ministry of Justice and Luxembourg Business Registers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Delivered annually during the first calendar quarter of each year; signed confirmation of current registered address and no change of activity must be provided before 31 March
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Loss of a valid Luxembourg registered office may trigger administrative strike-off by the RCS; the SCSp's partners may lose limited liability protection for transactions entered into after removal

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A statutory audit by an independent réviseur d'entreprises is required for the SCSp when it exceeds at least two of three thresholds for two consecutive financial years: balance sheet total of EUR 4.4 million, net turnover of EUR 8.8 million, and average workforce of 50 employees. Audit is also mandatory if the SCSp operates as a regulated CSSF/RCS investment vehicle or is part of a group required to be consolidated in Luxembourg.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Luxembourg GAAP under the Code de Commerce and the Law of 19 December 2002 transposing EU Directive 2013/34/EU; voluntary early adoption of IFRS as endorsed by the EU is permitted for unlisted entities; small SCSp entities may file abridged or simplified accounts.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The managing partner must maintain an up-to-date statutory register of beneficial owners and reconcile it against the RBE. Upon any transfer of partnership interests, the update must be submitted to the RBE within 30 days. Annually, within one month after the RBE anniversary, the gérant must positively confirm that filed UBO information remains accurate. The confirmation must be supported by updated declarations from all partners who hold 25% or more of interests or control rights.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute book of partner resolutions and annual meetings

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 3,000 - 6,000 (EUR 2,800 - 5,500) for professional domiciliation and corporate secretarial services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not required for below-threshold SCSp; if mandatory or voluntarily engaged, USD 8,000 - 20,000 (EUR 7,500 - 18,500) for a small bakery-chain partnership audit

stage_6.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulaire 460 (corporate income tax and municipal business tax return for taxable corporations) via the eTVA electronic filing portal (MyGuichet.lu); transparent SCSp files an annual informational allocation form / checklist
stage_6.statutory_deadline_rule: Within six months of fiscal year-end (LIR Article 161), administrative practice extends upon written request; the assessment office can impose a reminder with reduced additional deadline

field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Cross-border service invoices must meet beneficial ownership and arm's length requirements; substantiate with contracts and TP documentation

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3 – Non-deductible expenses and accrued direct taxes

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Offset of prior-year tax losses against current-year profit
